dataset_name: SmartBook CLIP+Qwen Book Cover Retrieval Seed Dataset
isbn_policy: No ISBNs fabricated. All selected depicted editions predate routine ISBN assignment; ISBN-13 fields are blank with an explicit status.
ground_truth_policy: Provisional source-verified title/author/edition labels; not yet checked against physical copies by independent annotators.
image_policy: Online source cover images are gallery/reference assets. Controlled perturbations must be generated only from downloaded originals and separately labelled as synthetic transformations, never as real photographs.
rights_policy: Source-page license statements recorded per image. This is not independent legal advice or blanket clearance for public redistribution.
download_status: No image binaries downloaded in this chat environment. The package includes source URLs and a local download/transform script.
main_limitations: Historical editions dominate the seed set and are not representative of current commercial book covers.
Many records have no ISBN because the depicted editions predate ISBN use.
Some Vietnamese images use Hán-Nôm, contain no visible title text, are low-resolution, or are composite scans; these require stratified analysis.
The current seed set is a pilot candidate corpus, not a statistically sufficient final benchmark.
The query variants generated from the same gallery image form a controlled perturbation benchmark and do not replace independently captured real-world query photos.
